{{Top|leg}}
'''Emberlene Essence''' was a musky fragrance that evoked memories of the deep woods of the destroyed planet [[Emberlene]]. Many [[Emberlene memorial shrine]]s were stocked with this essence for the refugees from Emberlene that wanted to remember their beautiful home world.<ref name="SWG:CE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Cam'doen's Enforcer|Naboo}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an agent of the [[Azure Cabal]] broke into a [[Mistryl Safehouse|Mistryl safe house]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and stole a bottle of Emberlene Essence. He used this fragrance during an attack on a [[M'dweshuui Stronghold|stronghold]] of the [[Cult of M'dweshuu]] to make the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] believe that they had been ambushed by the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] and incite a war between the two organizations.<ref name="SWG:CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Emberlene Essence appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Emberlene Essence was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
